primary_question: What should I check in playlist file references before moving music files?
working_title: Check Playlist References Before Moving Music Files
notes: Product-neutral editorial hypothesis: distinguish playlist references from media files, preserve backups and test a copied playlist before considering a user-chosen move. Verify the actual format and player behavior; do not promise automatic relinking or modify files. Distinct from recording identity and manual duplicate comparison. No app-capability or measured demand claim.
